tasks.label: Check Git publishing status
tasks.command: git status --short --branch; git remote -v; git log -1 --oneline

tasks.label: Stage application for GitHub
tasks.command: git add -- . ':!.vscode'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Staging failed' }; git diff --cached --stat; git diff --cached --name-only; git check-ignore .env.local .data/goals.sqlite node_modules .next

tasks.label: Verify staged application files
tasks.command: $files = @(git -c core.pager=cat diff --cached --name-only); $blocked = @($files | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(\.data/|node_modules/|\.next/|\.next-e2e/|test-results/|\.vscode/)' -or ($_ -match '^\.env' -and $_ -ne '.env.example') }); if ($blocked.Count) { throw 'Private or generated files are staged' }; Write-Output ('Staged files: ' + $files.Count); $files; git check-ignore .env.local .data/goals.sqlite node_modules .next

tasks.label: Commit and publish application
tasks.command: git commit -m "Add Goals Management application with PWA and PostgreSQL support"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Commit failed' }; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Publish Goals application
tasks.command: git commit -m 'Add Goals Management application with PWA and PostgreSQL support'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Commit failed' }; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Verify GitHub access
tasks.command: $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0'; $env:GCM_INTERACTIVE='never'; git -c credential.interactive=false -c http.connectTimeout=15 -c http.lowSpeedLimit=1 -c http.lowSpeedTime=20 ls-remote --heads origin main

tasks.label: Push application noninteractive
tasks.command: $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0'; $env:GCM_INTERACTIVE='never'; git -c credential.interactive=false -c http.connectTimeout=15 -c http.lowSpeedLimit=1 -c http.lowSpeedTime=20 push -u origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'GitHub push failed; authenticate directly with GitHub and retry' }; git -c core.pager=cat status --short --branch

tasks.label: Confirm published commit
tasks.command: $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0'; $env:GCM_INTERACTIVE='never'; $local = git rev-parse HEAD; $remote = git -c credential.interactive=false ls-remote --heads origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $remote -or -not $remote.StartsWith($local)) { throw 'Remote commit verification failed' }; Write-Output ('Verified GitHub main commit: ' + $local)

tasks.label: Format and check compact card files
tasks.command: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write src/components/products/product-card.jsx src/components/products/product-manager.jsx src/styles/catalog.css tests/e2e/workflow.spec.mjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Formatting failed' }; node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check src/components/products/product-card.jsx src/components/products/product-manager.jsx src/styles/catalog.css tests/e2e/workflow.spec.mjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Format check failed' }; node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src/components/products/product-card.jsx src/components/products/product-manager.jsx tests/e2e/workflow.spec.mjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Lint failed' }
